svg.text: Leaning stones (oval slab propped by a small stone)
56 W x 57 D x 108 H mm (lid included); flat foot 54 x 51; shell ~42 cm3, ~149 g with board 30 g + battery 55 g (assumed)
centre of mass 28 behind the foot's front edge, 49 up; tips at ~24° back / 30° forward (worst direction 23°); tilt15: 22 / 29, oval: 18 / 17
From the front and the seat: the pure oval, 56 x 33 in plan, leaning 15° with parallel front and back. Behind its heel a small round stone props it:
that is the foot, the cable garage (USB notch at its back) and room for ballast. Prop 46 wide, 36 deep, 29 high.
One shell and one lid: the slab's back wall starts on the prop's roof (45° inside); the slab's back does not exist inside the prop.
1 mm = 4 px, grid 10 mm. Blue-grey: stack box s 12..95 (along the face from the rim), t 3..26; dashed in it: real board+glass and battery. Blue: rods 8 x 66.65 at x ±10.23. Red: CoM, flat foot.
